lines.en: label dormwartwo3:
scene sky
Some time later in some other place, something starts to happen.
lines.zh: 过了一段时间，在另一个地方，有什么事开始发生了。

lines.en: It isn’t anything depressing, so there’s no need to worry the way you normally would.
lines.zh: 那不是什么令人沮丧的事，所以你不必像往常那样担心。

lines.en: In fact, all things considered, it’s quite joyous and quite fun. For today, on this day so scarred by frequent let downs and misguided goals, we find ourselves on the precipice of reconciliation.
lines.zh: 事实上，综合考虑，那是相当欢喜、也相当有趣的。因为今天，在这个被频繁的失望和误入歧途的目标弄得伤痕累累的日子里，我们发现自己正站在和解的边缘。

lines.en: Not between two separate people, but between one girl and the two visions she has of herself.
lines.zh: 不是两个不同的人之间的和解，而是一个女孩和她对自己的两种想象之间的和解。

lines.en: But before we can get to that, we must cross a bridge.
lines.zh: 不过在那之前，我们必须跨过一座桥。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas1
A bridge to a familiar apartment that, despite all expectations, has managed to cling to a sense of purity that many other locales have long since abandoned since you woke up.
lines.zh: 一座通向那间熟悉的公寓的桥——出乎所有人的意料，它至今仍紧握着一份纯粹，而自从你醒来之后，许多别的地方早已将那份纯粹抛弃。

lines.en: Two girls sit in the bedroom, playing with toys and snacking on celery sticks- but there is a third entity right there with them.
lines.zh: 两个女孩坐在卧室里，玩着玩具，啃着芹菜条——但还有第三个存在，就在她们身边。

lines.en: It is not the type of entity you know or fear.
lines.zh: 它不是你所认识、或所畏惧的那种存在。

lines.en: But it peers out from behind its glass in a 500 yen frame and longs to return to this world.
lines.zh: 但它透过一个 500 日元相框的玻璃向外凝视，渴望着回到这个世界。

lines.en: To pick up where it left off.
lines.zh: 好从它中断的地方继续下去。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas2
But it takes solace in the fact that there is someone else now carrying that torch, and understands that any job left incomplete will surely be finished by someone else.
lines.zh: 但令它欣慰的是，如今已有另一个人接过了那支火炬；它也明白，任何未完成的事，终将会有别人来完成。

lines.en: The final entity slips back into its frame.
lines.zh: 那最后的存在滑回了它的相框里。

lines.en: Or was it ever there at all?
lines.zh: 又或者，它从来就不曾在那儿？

lines.en: The answer will change depending on who you ask.
lines.zh: 答案会因为你问的人不同而改变。

lines.en: But, if you ask me-
lines.zh: 不过，如果你问我——

lines.en: It isn’t our body or our heart that makes us alive, but our ideals.
lines.zh: 让我们活着的不是我们的身体或心脏，而是我们的理想。

lines.en: And if there’s ever anyone willing to adopt those once your physical self leaves the picture, you can find comfort in the fact that there will always be another frame on a shelf in a house somewhere.
lines.zh: 如果有一天，在你的肉身退场之后，还有人愿意继承那些理想，那你大可安心——在某座房子里，架子上总会留着另一个相框。

lines.en: And that you’ll still be able to live on even when your flesh has rotted off of your bones.
lines.zh: 而即便你的血肉早已从骨头上腐烂殆尽，你依然能够继续活下去。

lines.en: : Guess who’s back from school!
lines.zh: : 猜猜谁放学回来了！

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas3
: Big sis Chika!
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐！

lines.en: : Candy!
: I see your priorities are the same as ever, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 我看你的优先顺序还是老样子啊，Tsukasa。

lines.en: : Of course they are! Why would I ever care about {i}you{/i} when you hold what I have been waiting for since the moment I arrived!
lines.zh: : 当然了！你手里拿着我从进门那一刻起就等着的东西，我凭什么要去在乎{i}你{/i}！

lines.en: : And just in time, too! If Chinami had to eat one more celery stick, she was going to run away from home!
lines.zh: : 而且来得正是时候！要是 Chinami 再吃一根芹菜，她就要离家出走了！

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas4
: Nuh-uh. Not if I have anything to do with it. Did you finish your homework for the day? Was Tsukasa able to help you?
lines.zh: : 不行。只要我还在，就不行。你今天的作业做完了吗？Tsukasa 有帮你吗？

lines.en: : Mhm! Tsukasa knows all sorts of things that Papa probably doesn’t even know! Like how to read earnings reports and what asset liquidation means!
lines.zh: : 嗯！Tsukasa 懂得好多爸爸大概都不知道的东西！比如怎么看财报，还有资产清算是什么意思！

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas5
: Huh? Did I print out the wrong vocabulary sheet or something? I don’t remember seeing anything about {i}asset liquidation.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哈？我打印错单词表了吗？我不记得上面有{i}资产清算{/i}这个词啊。

lines.en: : Your peasant vocabulary words will not prepare Chinami for the real world! If she is ever going to be a successful CEO, she needs to get ahead of the curve while she’s still young!
lines.zh: : 你那套平民词汇可没法让 Chinami 应对真实世界！她要是想成为一名成功的 CEO，就得趁还年轻抢在曲线前头！

lines.en: : That’s right! Big sis Chika...you’re fired! Now give Chinami her candy!
lines.zh: : 没错！Chika 姐姐……你被开除了！快把糖给 Chinami！

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas6
: I’m starting to think you might not be a very good influence on my little sister.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得，你对我妹妹可能不是什么好榜样。

lines.en: : Hey, {i}I’m{/i} not the one going around dressed like Clifford the Big Red Dog’s mistress. Now hand over the goods!
lines.zh: : 嘿，穿得像「大红狗 Clifford」的情妇一样到处晃的人可不是{i}我{/i}。快点把货交出来！

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas7
: Nuh-uh. Not until you say the thing. You know how this works, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 不行。你得先说那句话。你知道规矩的，对吧？

lines.en: : Of course I do! I’ve prepared all month for this!
lines.zh: : 我当然知道！我为了这个准备了整整一个月！

lines.en: : Treat!
lines.zh: : 给糖！

lines.en: : I think you forgot a couple words, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你漏了几个词啊，Tsukasa。

lines.en: : I’ve forgotten nothing. I know what I want and giving you options just lessens my chances of getting it.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没漏。我知道自己要什么，给你选择只会降低我拿到手的概率。

lines.en: : That’s okay. Chinami will take the trick as payment for learning about asset liquidation.
lines.zh: : 没关系。Chinami 收下「捣蛋」就好了，就当是学资产清算的报酬。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas8
: Your sacrifice will not be forgotten, Chinami. Tsukasa will remember this.
lines.zh: : 你的牺牲不会被遗忘，Chinami。Tsukasa 会记住这一点的。

lines.en: : As long as Chinami can have one piece with peanuts in-
lines.zh: : 只要 Chinami 能拿到一颗里面带花生的就好——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas9
: Rats! Foiled again!
lines.zh: : 可恶！又被摆了一道！

lines.en: : Aren’t you allergic to peanuts? Why are you always trying to kill yourself? If you have thoughts like that, you should talk to someone.
lines.zh: : 你不是对花生过敏吗？你干嘛老想弄死自己？如果你有那种念头，应该去跟人聊聊。

lines.en: : Okay, here. Take everything I’ve got. Just stop talking about sad stuff. You’re supposed to be having fun for the rest of the day now that your homework is done, not...whatever that was.
lines.zh: : 好了，给。我身上所有的都给你。别再说那些丧气话了。作业都做完了，你今天剩下的时间就该开开心心的，而不是……刚才那副样子。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas7
: Finally! My treat!
lines.zh: : 终于！我的糖！

lines.en: : Chinami’s trick!
lines.zh: : Chinami 的捣蛋！

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas10
: Yeah, yeah. Just don’t eat it all at once or you’ll get a tummy ache.
lines.zh: : 行啦行啦。别一口气全吃完，不然肚子会疼的。

lines.en: : Oh! And make sure you throw away all of the wrappers because I am {i}not{/i} going to be a happy dog if we get ants again!
lines.zh: : 哦！还有，一定记得把所有糖纸扔掉，要是又招来蚂蚁，我可就{i}不是{/i}一只开心的狗了！

lines.en: : I’ll have my newest butler come in and clean when he picks me up later!
lines.zh: : 我最新的那位管家待会儿来接我的时候，会进来打扫的！

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas11
: You should really just learn how to clean up after yourself, Tsukasa. You can’t lean on other people for the rest of forever.
lines.zh: : 你真该学会自己收拾，Tsukasa。你总不能一辈子都靠着别人。

lines.en: : You don’t even pay for your own phone bill! You have no right to tell me what I should or shouldn’t lean on others for!
lines.zh: : 你连自己的手机账单都付不起！你有什么资格教训我该不该依靠别人！

lines.en: : That’s a completely different-
lines.zh: : 那完全是两码——

lines.en: : Yo.
scene halloweenatchikas12
: Guh! Jesus, when did you walk in? I didn’t even hear you and you weren’t supposed to be here for, like...another hour.
lines.zh: : 咕！老天，你什么时候进来的？我一点声音都没听见，而且你本来该再过一个小时才到的。

lines.en: : Right before that brat started shit talking you in your own house.
lines.zh: : 就在那小屁孩开始在你自己家里说你坏话之前。

lines.en: : What happened to keepin’ the door locked? What if I was one of those homeless people coming to take all your shit?
lines.zh: : 说好的锁门呢？要我是那种跑来把你家东西全搬走的流浪汉怎么办？

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas13
: Then you probably would have gotten distracted by my costume and given me enough time to chain you to the stove and call the cops.
lines.zh: : 那你大概会被我这身装扮吸引住，好让我有足够时间把你拴在炉子上然后报警。

lines.en: : {i}That’s{/i} your costume?
lines.zh: : {i}这就是{/i}你的装扮？

lines.en: : Mhm. Is there a problem?
lines.zh: : 嗯。有问题吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. Where’s the rest of it?
lines.zh: : 有。剩下的部分呢？

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas14
: Dunno. Sensei’s bedroom floor, maybe?
lines.zh: : 不知道。也许在老师卧室的地板上？

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas15
: Yumi?
lines.zh: : Yumi？

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. Ain’t been gettin’ much sleep lately.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。最近一直没怎么睡好。

lines.en: : I bet. Having a king-size bed and a room all to yourself sounds like it can get pretty exhausting. I have no idea how you do it.
lines.zh: : 那当然。一个人睡特大号床、独占一整间房，听起来就够累人的。我真不知道你是怎么熬过来的。

lines.en: : {i}Did{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 我{i}熬过来了{/i}。

lines.en: : Are you seriously trying to police my grammar despite having a total of like, four high school lessons under your belt?
lines.zh: : 你总共也就上过大概四节高中课吧，还来挑我的语法？

lines.en: : No. I’m saying I moved out again. Ain’t crashin’ there anymore.
lines.zh: : 不是。我是说我搬出来了。不再赖在那儿了。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas16
: Ah! Then...does that mean-
lines.zh: : 啊！那……是不是意味着——

lines.en: : Yup. Got yourself a full time babysitter again. Hope you’re happy.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你又有了一个全职保姆。希望你开心。

lines.en: : I am! Super happy! This is the best news I’ve gotten in like, forever!
lines.zh: : 我开心！超开心！这简直是我好久以来听到的最好的消息！

lines.en: : You do realize that {i}I’m{/i} the one who’s supposed to be getting {i}you{/i} a birthday present, right? Because you coming back is like, the second best present I could have ever gotten.
lines.zh: : 你知道本来该是{i}我{/i}送{i}你{/i}生日礼物的吧？因为你能回来，简直就是我能收到的第二好的礼物了。

lines.en: : The first being?
lines.zh: : 第一好的是什么？

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas17
: Front row Niki tickets.
lines.zh: : Niki 演唱会的第一排门票。

lines.en: : Ain’t that Noriko girl related to her? Just get ‘em from her. Probably gets a crazy discount at the very least.
lines.zh: : 那个 Noriko 不是她亲戚吗？找她要啊。至少也能拿到个离谱的折扣吧。

lines.en: : They’re way too expensive to just come out and ask for, so I’ve been waiting for her to say something about it first and-
lines.zh: : 那票太贵了，实在不好意思开口要，所以我一直等着她先提起来，然后——

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas18
: Wait. Fuck. I left your present at school.
lines.zh: : 等等。操。我把你的礼物落在学校了。

lines.en: : Hm? You got me a present? Why?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你给我买了礼物？为什么？

lines.en: : Uhh...because you’re my best friend?
lines.zh: : 呃……因为你是我最好的朋友啊？

lines.en: : Okay...but I ain’t ever gotten you anything for your birthday.
lines.zh: : 好吧……可我从来没送过你生日礼物啊。

lines.en: : All that matters to me is your happiness.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，你的幸福才是最重要的。

lines.en: : What size are your shoes again? Might be able to raise enough money to get you a pair by the end of next year.
lines.zh: : 你鞋码多少来着？也许我能凑够钱，赶在明年年底前给你买一双。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas19
: Happy birthday, Yumi. I’m glad you’re home.
lines.zh: : 生日快乐，Yumi。我很高兴你回来了。

lines.en: : Yeah...whatever. Where’s the twerp? Haven’t seen her in a while and should probably apologize for leavin’ if I’m gonna be stayin’ here again.
lines.zh: : 嗯……随便啦。那小鬼头呢？好久没见她了，既然又要住回来，大概该跟她道个歉。

lines.en: scene black
: Chinami! Look who decided to show up!
lines.zh: : Chinami！看看谁来了！

lines.en: : Amazon Prime?!
lines.zh: : Amazon Prime？！

lines.en: : Even better!
lines.zh: : 比那更好！

lines.en: : Than Amazon Prime?! I don’t believe it! That’s-
lines.zh: : 比 Amazon Prime 还好？！我不信！那是——

lines.en: : Oh. It’s just some girl. Boring.
lines.zh: : 哦。只是个女的。无聊。

lines.en: : Big sis Yumi! You’re still alive! This {i}is{/i} better than Amazon Prime!
lines.zh: : Yumi 姐姐！你还活着！这比 Amazon Prime {i}还好{/i}！

lines.en: : Ugh. You poor people are so uncivilized. I bet she doesn’t even have a Rolex.
lines.zh: : 呃。你们这些穷人真是没开化。我打赌她连块劳力士都没有。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas20

The house that had grown so lonely and so quiet these recent days was, once again, filled with noise as its third resident moved through the entryway for the first time in what felt like forever to everyone involved.
lines.zh: 近日来变得如此冷清寂寥的这栋房子，又一次被喧闹填满——它的第三位住客穿过玄关走了进来，对所有人而言，这感觉像是隔了永恒那么久之后的第一次。

lines.en: And while they are no family by traditional standards, the ways in which they care for one another make them just as viable as any household not disadvantaged by the shape and flavor of their DNA.
lines.zh: 虽然按传统标准她们算不上一家人，但她们彼此关照的方式，让她们和任何一个没有被 DNA 的形状与滋味拖累的家庭一样成立。

lines.en: A picture in a frame on a shelf in a house gazes on with unblinking eyes, but everyone inside is too caught up in the moment to remember she’s there.
lines.zh: 房子里，架子上相框中的一张照片，一眨不眨地注视着这一切——但屋里的每个人都太沉浸于此刻，早已记不起她还在那儿。

lines.en: But that’s fine.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。

lines.en: Because it’s moments like this that remind her she doesn’t need to be.
lines.zh: 因为正是这样的时刻让她明白，她并不需要被记起。

lines.en: And the fact that there is still a family at all is everything she could have ever wanted if she was able to want in the first place.
lines.zh: 而「家人还在」这件事本身，就是她若真能有所渴求，所能渴求的一切。

lines.en: Maybe she is. Maybe she isn’t.
lines.zh: 也许她能。也许她不能。

lines.en: The answer will change depending on who you ask.
lines.zh: 答案会因为你问的人不同而改变。

lines.en: So choose whichever one makes you the happiest and be sure to answer with that if {i}you’re{/i} the one who ever receives the question.
lines.zh: 所以，挑那个让你最开心的答案吧，并且——如果有一天轮到{i}你{/i}来回答这个问题——就用它作答。

lines.en: : So...remember that thing I texted you about earlier?
lines.zh: : 那么……还记得我之前发短信跟你说的那件事吗？

lines.en: : Wouldn’t be here right now if I didn’t. Shit woke me up from a nap, so it better be important.
lines.zh: : 不记得我就不会在这儿了。那条短信把我从午睡里吵醒，所以最好是很重要的事。

lines.en: : It is. I need your help with something.
lines.zh: : 确实。我需要你帮个忙。

lines.en: : Like...{i}me?{/i} Or the Yakuza? Cause I ain’t really sure how Gary is gonna feel about lending you a hand after all that shit you said to him.
lines.zh: : 比如……让{i}我{/i}帮？还是让山口组帮？毕竟你对 Gary 说了那么多难听的话，我真不确定他还愿不愿意伸手。

lines.en: : First off, I mean {i}you.{/i} Second, fuck Gary. And third, can you agree to lend me a hand before I even tell you what it is?
lines.zh: : 第一，我是说{i}你{/i}。第二，去他妈的 Gary。第三，你能不能在我说出具体是什么之前先答应帮我？

lines.en: : Fuck no. We might be friends, but that doesn’t mean I’m just gonna blindly do whatever the fuck you need me to do. Gotta put myself first. You know that.
lines.zh: : 他妈的当然不行。我们也许是朋友，但这不代表我会闭着眼睛去做你要我做的任何事。我得先顾好自己。你知道的。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas21

: I mean...{i}yeah.{/i} But given how opposed to it you were last year, I doubt you’re just going to flat out agree. And this might be a good chance to start getting back on everybody’s good side again.
lines.zh: : 我是说……{i}也对。{/i}不过考虑到你去年有多反对，我也不指望你会一口答应。而且这也许是个好机会，让你重新开始挽回大家的好感。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas22
: Hah...didn’t I already tell you I don’t really give a shit about bein’ on everybody’s good side?
lines.zh: : 哈……我不是早跟你说过，我压根不在乎什么大家的好感吗？

lines.en: : My plan for droppin’ out still stands, you know. Just because I’m movin’ out of my dad’s place doesn’t mean I’m backtracking on {i}everything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我退学的打算可没变，你知道吗。我搬出我爸那儿，不代表我要把之前的{i}一切{/i}都推翻。

lines.en: : I’m just...reevaluating certain shit. Tryin’ to move {i}forward{/i} again so I don’t wind up like...
lines.zh: : 我只是在……重新评估一些破事。想试着再{i}往前走{/i}，免得最后变成……

lines.en: : Well, like somebody really shitty.
lines.zh: : 嗯，变成一个很烂的人。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas23
: Also, what’s this shit about last year? All we did for Halloween last year was that fuckin’ party thing and I was only there for like, ten minutes.
lines.zh: : 还有，去年那档子事是怎么回事？去年万圣节我们不就办了那个该死的派对吗，我总共也就待了十分钟。

lines.en: : We decided to combine the Halloween party with the Dorm Wars this year. And with you being gone, it means that it’s nine against ten.
lines.zh: : 今年我们决定把万圣节派对和宿舍大战合并。而你不在，就意味着是九对十。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas24
: Then take the one loss and make up for it in other contests or whatever. Don’t drag me into it.
lines.zh: : 那就认下这一场输，在其他比赛里补回来不就得了。别把我扯进来。

lines.en: : But I want to win Sensei! And I want people to like you again!
lines.zh: : 可是我想赢下老师！而且我也想让大家重新喜欢你！

lines.en: : Nobody ever liked me, Chika.
lines.zh: : 从来就没有人喜欢过我，Chika。

lines.en: : Okay, then I want people to be mildly conflicted in regard to your existence again!
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我希望大家对你的存在重新产生一点温和的矛盾情绪！

lines.en: : Plus, Nodoka volunteered to go up against you and this might be a good way to kick her ass without {i}literally kicking her ass{/i} in front of everyone.
lines.zh: : 再说了，Nodoka 主动提出要和你对阵，这也许是个好办法——让你能揍她一顿，又不用当着所有人的面{i}真把她揍一顿{/i}。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas25
: Nah...There ain’t no way the others would be cool with that if everything I’ve heard from you is true. The fuck would they even want me there for?
lines.zh: : 拉倒吧……要是从你这儿听来的都是真的，其他人不可能答应。他们到底图什么，非要把我拉进去？

lines.en: : Honestly? I think pretty much everybody is rooting for Nodoka to win to, like...try and give her some sort of revenge and make you look like an idiot or something.
lines.zh: : 说实话？我觉得几乎所有人都盼着 Nodoka 赢，好，那个……算是给她某种复仇，顺便让你出个大丑什么的。

lines.en: : Ain’t really sellin’ me on this, you know. And I got no clue if I’d even be able to be {i}around{/i} her without trying to kill her again.
lines.zh: : 你这可真没说服我，你知道吗。而且我压根不确定自己能不能待在她{i}旁边{/i}，忍住不再想杀了她。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas26

: But you’re better than that! I know you are. And if you really {i}are{/i} trying to move forward, wouldn’t it be good to, like...try and get revenge in a way that doesn’t lead to everyone fearing you?
lines.zh: : 可你比那更好啊！我知道的。如果你{i}真的{/i}想往前走，那……试着用一种不会让所有人都怕你的方式去复仇，不是很好吗？

lines.en: : Even if I do say yes and I {i}do{/i} win...the hell is that going to do for my reputation? Not like people are gonna forget I nearly gave her a concussion because I won some stupid contest.
lines.zh: : 就算我答应了、也{i}赢{/i}了……那对我的名声又有什么用？难不成大家会因为我赢了个破比赛，就忘了我是怎么差点把她打成脑震荡的？

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas27
: The second floor, probably not. They all seem pretty close with one another.
lines.zh: : 二楼的人大概不会。她们看起来关系都挺铁的。

lines.en: : But if you {i}do{/i} win and bring the first floor one step closer to winning the whole Dorm War, I’m sure {i}some{/i} girls might appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 但如果你{i}赢{/i}了，让一楼离赢下整场宿舍大战更近一步，我相信{i}有些{/i}女孩会感激你的。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like you’re just desperate to not go through the war thing with a one man handicap.
lines.zh: : 听起来你只是不想带着「少一个人」的劣势去打这场仗罢了。

lines.en: : Aren’t friends supposed to go to war for one another, though? I literally fought off the Yakuza for you.
lines.zh: : 可朋友不就是该为彼此上战场吗？我可是真的为你跟山口组干过一架。

lines.en: : I {i}called off{/i} the Yakuza while you were fighting them.
lines.zh: : 你在跟他们打的时候，是我把山口组{i}叫停{/i}的。

lines.en: : Sure, but we all know that I would have won in the end, right?
lines.zh: : 当然，但我们都知道，最后赢的人会是我，对吧？

lines.en: : I don’t know, Chika...The fuck would I even be competing in?
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Chika……我到底要比个什么啊？

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah, good question. I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 哦。是啊，问得好。我不知道。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas28
: Yeah, I’m not sure if your thingy was decided on yet. I left school before all of that stuff was distributed, so all I really know is my contest and what came before me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不确定你的项目定下来了没有。那些东西分发之前我就离校了，所以我真正知道的只有我自己的比赛，以及排在我前面的那些。

lines.en: : Can you, like...find out?
lines.zh: : 你能不能……去打听一下？

lines.en: : Sure. Come with me to the kitchen so I can get my phone. I’ll ask right now.
lines.zh: : 当然。跟我来厨房，我去拿手机。我现在就问。

lines.en: : Hah...fine. Whatever.
lines.zh: : 哈……行吧。随便你。

lines.en: scene black
scene halloweenatchikas29
: There. Text sent. I’ve just gotta wait for Ayane to fill me in now.
lines.zh: : 好了。短信发出去了。现在就等 Ayane 回我了。

lines.en: : Listen, Chika...I ain’t tryin’ to get your hopes up and shit when this is obviously a thing you really care about...
lines.zh: : 听着，Chika……我可不是想吊你胃口什么的，毕竟这显然是你很在乎的事……

lines.en: : But if this is something weird or...some shit I’m not comfortable with, I can’t guarantee I’ll be cool with...you know, {i}doing{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 但如果这事儿很怪，或者……是我不太舒服的那些破事，我可不敢保证我会愿意……你知道的，{i}去做{/i}。

lines.en: : So if I do back down, it ain’t personal.
lines.zh: : 所以如果我临阵退缩了，那不是针对你。

lines.en: : I know. And I’m sure it’ll be fine. If worse comes to worst, I can probably convince Sensei and Imani to let me take your place as, like...a one time exception thing.
lines.zh: : 我知道。而且我确定不会有事的。最坏的情况，我大概能说服老师和 Imani，让我顶替你的位置，就当是……一次性的特例。

lines.en: : Cool...yeah.
: You’d probably be better off than me in the first place. Ain’t much I’m really {i}good{/i} at, you know?
lines.zh: : 反正你一开始就会比我更适合。我没什么真正{i}擅长{/i}的东西，你知道的。

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas30
: Oh, stop. I’m sure you’ll be plenty good at...
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这么说。我相信你肯定会很擅长……
: 擅长……

lines.en: scene halloweenatchikas31
: Good luck.
lines.zh: : 祝你好运。

lines.en: scene black
I collapse onto the bed, knowing full well that I’m going to be dragged out of it first thing in the morning so that nineteen (Or twenty) girls can fight over what to do with my body.
lines.zh: 我瘫倒在床上，心里很清楚，明早天一亮我就会被从床上拖起来，好让十九个（或者二十个）女孩为该怎么处置我的身体争个不休。

lines.en: But between the scattered worries of what this could mean for both my physical safety and mental health, I thank whatever forces led me to this moment.
lines.zh: 但在那些零散的担忧之间——担忧这对我的人身安全和精神状态意味着什么——我仍要感谢一切将我引向此刻的力量。

lines.en: Because if it were not for them, I’d likely still be so numb that I wouldn’t be able to feel things like this at all.
lines.zh: 因为若不是它们，我大概至今仍麻木得根本感受不到这些。

lines.en: But that’s just a fleeting thought that serves to distract me from the sad truth that I’ll never know anything about myself at all.
lines.zh: 可那不过是个转瞬即逝的念头，用来让我不去面对那个可悲的事实——我对自己一无所知。

lines.en: And that everything I do is just served up on a platter by people I’m expected to trust.
lines.zh: 而我所做的一切，都只是被那些我被要求去信任的人，盛在盘子里端到我面前。

lines.en: What is real?
lines.zh: 什么是真的？

lines.en: What is not?
lines.zh: 什么不是？

lines.en: These are the things I think of as I begin to fall asleep.
lines.zh: 这些就是我开始入睡时想着的事。

lines.en: But what I dream of is much darker.
lines.zh: 但我所做的梦，要黑暗得多。
